"""RoboLab eai-standard/2.2 episode client and repeatable control helpers."""
import os, sys, time, json, traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print('CONNECTED', r.base)
print('STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
print('PROTOCOL', spec.get('protocol'), 'BUDGET', spec.get('budget'))
print('WORLD', json.dumps(spec.get('world')))
print('ACTION_TYPES', json.dumps(spec.get('action_types')))
print('JOINTS', json.dumps(spec.get('robot_spec')))
print('PROPRIO_LAYOUT', json.dumps(spec.get('proprio_layout')))
print('PROPRIO_GROUPS', json.dumps(spec.get('proprio_groups')))
print('CAMERAS', json.dumps(spec.get('cameras')))

def obs(label='obs', depth=True):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
    for cam, a in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    if depth:
        for cam, a in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}_depth.npy', a)
    print('OBS', label, 'status=', json.dumps(r.status()))
    print('PROPRIO_NOW', o.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now'))
    return o

def submit(action_type, actions, dt=None, note='', video='mp4', video_fps=10):
    try:
        res = r.submit(action_type, actions, dt=dt, note=note, video=video, video_fps=video_fps)
    except Exception as e:
        print('SUBMIT_ERROR', repr(e))
        try:
            print('WAIT_READY', json.dumps(r.wait_ready(timeout=1200)))
            print('POST_ERROR_STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
        except Exception as ee:
            print('RECOVERY_ERROR', repr(ee))
        raise
    print('RESULT', json.dumps(res.meta))
    print('STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
    if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio): print('FINAL_PROPRIO', res.proprio[-1].tolist())
    for cam, a in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT / f'last_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    if video == 'both' or video == 'frames':
        for cam, a in res.frames.items():
            if len(a): Image.fromarray(a[-1]).save(OUT / f'last_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    return res

"""RoboLab eai-standard/2.2 episode client and repeatable control helpers."""
import os, sys, time, json, traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print('CONNECTED', r.base)
print('STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
print('PROTOCOL', spec.get('protocol'), 'BUDGET', spec.get('budget'))
print('WORLD', json.dumps(spec.get('world')))
print('ACTION_TYPES', json.dumps(spec.get('action_types')))
print('JOINTS', json.dumps(spec.get('robot_spec')))
print('PROPRIO_LAYOUT', json.dumps(spec.get('proprio_layout')))
print('PROPRIO_GROUPS', json.dumps(spec.get('proprio_groups')))
print('CAMERAS', json.dumps(spec.get('cameras')))

def obs(label='obs', depth=True):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none')
    for cam, a in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    if depth:
        for cam, a in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}_depth.npy', a)
    print('OBS', label, 'status=', json.dumps(r.status()))
    print('PROPRIO_NOW', o.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now'))
    return o

def submit(action_type, actions, dt=None, note='', video='mp4', video_fps=10):
    try:
        res = r.submit(action_type, actions, dt=dt, note=note, video=video, video_fps=video_fps)
    except Exception as e:
        print('SUBMIT_ERROR', repr(e))
        try:
            print('WAIT_READY', json.dumps(r.wait_ready(timeout=1200)))
            print('POST_ERROR_STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
        except Exception as ee:
            print('RECOVERY_ERROR', repr(ee))
        raise
    print('RESULT', json.dumps(res.meta))
    print('STATUS', json.dumps(r.status()))
    if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio): print('FINAL_PROPRIO', res.proprio[-1].tolist())
    for cam, a in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT / f'last_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    if video == 'both' or video == 'frames':
        for cam, a in res.frames.items():
            if len(a): Image.fromarray(a[-1]).save(OUT / f'last_{cam}.jpg', quality=94)
    return res
